text: 据新华社报道，当地时间9月12日下午，国家主席习近平在印度新德里出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤期间会见印度总理莫迪。两国领导人坦诚深入交换意见，就中印要做伙伴达成重要共识。 习近平指出，中方始终从战略高度和长远角度看待和发展中印关系。近两年，我同莫迪总理两次会晤，引领中印关系从“再出发”实现“再提升”。两国机制性交往逐步恢复，合作清单不断拉长，双边贸易额再创新高。这一局面来之不易，值得珍惜。中印两国国情不同，完全可以取长补短、相互支持、彼此成就、共同发展。面对变乱交织的国际形势，中国和印度作为世界上人口最多的两个国家和全球南方重要成员，肩负重要责任。双方
text_en: According to Xinhua News Agency, on the afternoon of September 12 local time, President Xi Jinping met with Indian Prime Minister Modi during the 18th BRICS Leaders' Meeting in New Delhi, India. The leaders of the two countries had a candid and in-depth exchange of views and reached an important consensus that China and India should be partners. Xi Jinping pointed out that China has always viewed and developed China-India relations from a strategic height and long-term perspective. Over the past two years, I have met with Prime Minister Modi twice, guiding China-India relations from "starting anew" to achieving "further elevation." Institutional exchanges between the two countries have gradually resumed, the cooperation list has continued to lengthen, and bilateral trade volume has hit a new high. This situation has not come easily and is worth cherishing. China and India have different national conditions, and can fully draw on each other's strengths, support each other, enable each other's success, and develop together. In the face of a turbulent and intertwined international situation, China and India, as the world's two most populous countries and important members of the Global South, shoulder important responsibilities.
